headlines.headline: Nvidia interim CEO Kress will need to deliver pristine Q3 numbers tonight (and face off internally against Jensen Huang’s daughter Madison)
headlines.description: Good morning. On Fortune’s radar today: Nvidia Q3 earnings tonight: Here’s what you need to know , post-Jensen.
